alignments.note: The indefinite adverb expanded into the frame by any means; head on any, the word carrying the sense, with means the generic completion (rules 17, 69).
παραζηλόω to provoke to jealousy, a resultative rendering headed on the meaning-bearing complement (rule 17); a head on provoke remains defensible, and 11:11 is analysed the same way under rule 24.
Genitive pronoun realized by the English possessive my.

Corrected from unrepresented. The ASV recasts the object into a finite relative clause and writes a separate antecedent pronoun them, which rule 92 assigns to the article: them that were at GAL.1.17 and they who are at JUD.1.12 are the same shape. That μου has already taken the determiner slot with my does not block this, because an antecedent pronoun is not a determiner a genitive pronoun can displace — rule 89's REV.19.5 makes exactly that point for an address word, the possessive slot there being occupied by αὐτοῦ while the article still takes ye. Rule 20's displacement reaches the determiner only. Folding them onto σάρκα with the rest of the supplied frame remains defensible and is what the earlier reading took, but it leaves the article empty where a source token stands to own the pronoun.
With the antecedent pronoun on the article, the expressed noun keeps the supplied relativizer and copula that are, discontinuously under rule 15 (rule 92).
Modal auxiliary rides with the finite verb; head on the lexical verb (rules 9, 17).

review_notes: Corrected the single unit for τήν: the supplied antecedent pronoun them belongs to the article under rule 92's separate-antecedent clause, not folded onto the noun with the rest of the supplied frame.

Rule 20 does not empty the article here, because what it displaces is a determiner and them is not one; rule 89's REV.19.5 is the governing analogy, an address word surviving an occupied possessive slot.
All 11 source and 20 target IDs partitioned exactly once in the corrected array.
πώς headed on any rather than the generic means, and παραζηλώσω on jealousy as at 11:11.
